I am a young man here in Mwanza with just a small piece of land, 0.37 hectares, and maize is what feeds my family. I will try to get the FISP coupon this year so I can buy NPK and urea — without the subsidy the price is too much for me. I will put some manure from the goats, plant hybrid seed if the coupon gives it, and intercrop with pigeon pea or beans like we always do. I cannot irrigate, I just wait for the rains, and most of the work I do myself with my wife; maybe I hire a few people for weeding if the weeds come strong.
